fields.PRODUCT NAME: Rajasthani Handcrafted Wooden Salad & Serving Bowl
fields.DESCRIPTION: Crafted with care by skilled artisans of Rajasthan, this handcrafted wooden bowl beautifully showcases the natural grain and texture of wood. Its deep, rounded design makes it perfect for serving salads, fruits, snacks, or even as a decorative centrepiece. Polished to a smooth, glossy finish, the bowl combines traditional craftsmanship with modern utility, bringing a warm, rustic touch to your dining experience.
